targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "LABEL") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["exchange_name"] == "${exchange}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["symbol"] == "${symbol}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pnl" or r["_field"] == "cumulative_pnl") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "LABEL") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["exchange_name"] == "${exchange}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["symbol"] == "${symbol}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pnl_return" or r["_field"] == "direction_label") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "LABEL") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["exchange_name"] == "${exchange}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["symbol"] == "${symbol}") |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^ema_pnl_return/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")
